newsitem.title: INDIA: India's TELCO up in after-hours trade.
newsitem.headline: India's TELCO up in after-hours trade.

text.p: Shares of India's leading truckmaker Tata Engineering & Locomotive Company Ltd (TELCO) jumped 11 rupees, or nearly three percent, to 404 in after-hours kerb deals in Bombay, traders said on Tuesday.
TELCO shares closed 7.0 rupees lower at 393 on the Bombay Stock Exchange.

Traders said speculators were bidders in off-market deals on rumours that the firm's net profit was likely to be above market expectations at 7.63 billion rupees in 1996/97, up from 5.3 billion in the previous year.
Company officials said the rumours could not be confirmed and added that the results, due to be announced on Tuesday, had not yet been released.
